answer: Juror weight is earned on hidden gold seats. One seat in 8 is a planted answer with a known grade; a key climbs a terrace of weight tiers (0, 0.25, 0.5, 1) per 25 gold seats graded within half a point, and one bad miss drops a tier. A fresh alias starts hollow at weight 0, so 1,000 new keys move no verdict; each needs ~600 careful reads, and with seats rationed to 10 per key per epoch the climb is glacier-slow, ~20 epochs a tier. Copying another juror fails because gold seats differ per key. Risk: leaked gold, so each item retires after 3 uses.
